Run Spotify →

Paste a Spotify track, album, playlist, artist, show or episode link. Save favorites to your private Dock account and listen using Spotify’s official embedded player. No developer API key is needed.

Spotify controls playback availability, sign-in and previews. Connect Spotify to search the catalog and display your playlists. Create a Spotify Developer app, enable Web API, and register https://chatgpt.ethan-grandpre0360.workers.dev/projects/spotify/run.html as its Redirect URI. Enter the app’s public Client ID in Connect Spotify. Do not enter a client secret. Account eligibility and development-mode allowlists are controlled by Spotify. This player does not provide unrestricted full-track streaming.
